subject: OrionEdge: request to add new subprocessor + Order Form amendment
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@orionedge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@orionedge.com>, legal@orionedge.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed subprocessor addition — LambdaOps (request + addendum)

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well — quick heads up from our side. We've contracted a new operational partner, LambdaOps, to provide managed logging and transient KV storage for certain customer telemetry used by our integration layer. LambdaOps will only process limited telemetry (service-level metrics and anonymized runtime traces) and will not get access to PII.

Per our MSA, we need your acceptance of this subprocessor and a small Order Form amendment acknowledging the change and the limited scope. I've attached a one-page Addendum (OrionEdge_Subproc_Addendum_v1.pdf) and the LambdaOps SOC2 report (redacted) for your review. We've also included our completed subprocessor questionnaire in the XLSX.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood needs any further evidence or a specific flow-down clause template? We're aiming to have this live by April 1 to align with our rollout.

Thanks,
Michael Turner
Head of Integrations | OrionEdge
+1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: OrionEdge_Subproc_Addendum_v1.pdf, OrionEdge_SOC2_Type2_2027.zip, OrionEdge_Subprocessor_Questionnaire.xlsx

Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor addition — LambdaOps (request + addendum)

Michael — thanks for the heads up and the packet. Looping in Contracts (Laura) and Sales (Priyom) so we can triage.

Quick checklist on our side:
- We need the SOC 2 report and the completed questionnaire (received) — security will confirm scope.
- Legal will review the Addendum and confirm whether a standard flow-down is sufficient or if we need a redline.
- Procurement will need the Order Form amendment drafted against your current Order Form; do you want us to propose the minimal language or will OrionEdge circulate a doc for signature?

Laura / Priyom — can you take the lead on legal redlines and the order form amendment respectively? Vanessa will handle security vetting once Mark (sec) confirms.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@orionedge.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor addition — LambdaOps (request + addendum)

Hi Michael — thanks for the materials. I did an initial pass on the Addendum and the questionnaire. A few items for clarification before we sign off: 

1) Flow-down obligations: The Addendum doesn't currently include a carve-out that ensures the LambdaOps subprocessor inherits our data processing obligations (DPA obligations) exactly as Redwood requires. We usually request the following minimum language inserted into the Addendum: that the subprocessor is bound by terms no less protective than the MSA/DPA and that Redwood has the right to audit or require evidence of controls.

2) Sub-subcontracting: Please confirm whether LambdaOps will engage any subcontractors for the KV storage piece. If yes, provide a list of those entities and their countries of operation.

3) Retention and deletion: The Addendum needs a short clause confirming data retention (max retention window for telemetry) and deletion on termination or at our direction.

4) Liability cap carve-out: Given this touches telemetry that could affect customer observability, we need confirmation that liability allocations under your Order Form are not reduced for LambdaOps processing.

Priyom — we should be able to handle this as a minor addendum if OrionEdge accepts our minimal redlines. Priyom, can you confirm whether Sales wants to propose the Order Form amendment or have OrionEdge send a draft?

I'll prepare a redline of the Addendum (tracked) and push it back to Michael + legal. Vanessa — can you get Mark (sec) to confirm that LambdaOps' SOC2 coverage includes the specific service categories in question (logging, KV) and that encryption key control is acceptable?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Michael Turner <m.turner@orionedge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@orionedge.com>, legal@orionedge.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor addition — LambdaOps (request + addendum)

Laura / Vanessa — appreciate the fast review. Answers inline: 

1) Flow-down obligations: LambdaOps will sign an agreement flow-down that mirrors OrionEdge's DPA; we'll attach that to the Addendum.

2) Sub-subcontracting: Not at launch — LambdaOps currently runs the stack in-house. If that changes, they'll provide notice and a list as required by the MSA.

3) Retention and deletion: LambdaOps confirms a 30-day max retention for telemetry; deletion on termination can be triggered by a documented request from OrionEdge.

4) Liability cap: OrionEdge confirms their Order Form allocation remains in effect; they won't attempt to shift or lower caps for LambdaOps.

Attached: updated PDF Addendum with a proposed flow-down paragraph (OrionEdge_Subproc_Addendum_v1.pdf) and the SOC2 artifact (full redacted zip). Please confirm if that's sufficient and if Redwood wants us to (a) add specific Redwood-prescribed wording, or (b) accept Redwood's redline. Our legal prefers (a) — we can incorporate your language into the addendum and execute rapidly.

Michael

Attachments: OrionEdge_Subproc_Addendum_v1.pdf (updated), OrionEdge_SOC2_Type2_2027.zip

From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor addition — LambdaOps (request + addendum)

Thanks team — reviewed the updated Addendum. Good news: the flow-down paragraph as drafted addresses the inheritance of DPA obligations but it's a little high level. I made three targeted edits (tracked) which Ill attach to Laura's redline:

• Explicit audit right on controls relevant to the services LambdaOps provides (scoped to logging/KV).
• Language requiring encryption key controls to be documented and attestable by LambdaOps (or by OrionEdge) and preserved for the retention window.
• A requirement that OrionEdge notify Redwood of any security incident involving LambdaOps within 72 hours and commit to remedial steps.

Laura — please incorporate my edits into one redline and send back to Michael/legal. Priyom — once we have their sign-off on the text, we can treat the Order Form amendment as ministerial. Vanessa — security confirms SOC2 coverage is adequate for the listed categories; they flagged one exception in the SOC2 report around change management for a small internal service at LambdaOps — ask OrionEdge to confirm mitigation.

I'll be out Thur-Fri this week but available for an escalation call Wed if needed.

Markus Klein
VP Legal & Security Liaison | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
